title: biomes.wrecks/1
description: data/biomes/wrecks.json: the liftable wreck (Game Design 23d section 8 item 20; WorldWrecks). Version field: schema. Policy: every key required, objects closed except keys starting with an underscore. Order checks (tierLift never falls, scaleMin within scaleMax) are WorldWrecks' own load and wrecks_check.

reachBh.description: How near the fighter must be, in body heights, to the wreck's box.

nearBh.description: No living civilian in a building within this many body heights of the wreck's edge.

fighters.description: A fighter near the wreck counts as living too.

fill.description: A wreck's mass is this share of its building's volume (cubic body heights).

minMass.description: A smaller wreck is not worth lifting.

items.description: The heaviest wreck this tier lifts.

tierLift.description: Per tier from 1; never falls as the tier rises (WorldWrecks' load).

speed.description: The scrap's speed in the brunt ladder's terms.

massRef.description: The mass at which the damage and radius are as written.

scaleMin.description: Lowest damage scale (square root of mass over massRef).

radiusBh.description: The burst's radius in body heights at massRef.
